name: chat-capsule
description: Move your AI work, not just your chat. Capture → Compress → Verify → Continue on any AI platform.

scripts.lint: npx --yes eslint lib/ extension/ tests/run.js tests/security-audit.js --ext .js --no-eslintrc -c .eslintrc.json --max-warnings 0 --ignore-pattern extension/content/capture-runtime.js
scripts.validate-manifest: node -e "const m = JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('manifest.json','utf8')); if (m.manifest_version !== 3) throw new Error('Not MV3'); console.log('manifest.json OK — v' + m.version);"
scripts.build: echo 'Chat Capsule is a Chrome extension — load unpacked from the repo root. No build step required.'
